summary: New engineer onboarding: Okta JIT/SCIM lag prevents SSH key attachment and blocks internal repo clones
summary_long: A recently onboarded engineer cannot clone internal repositories. The user's Okta account exists and SSO login works for web console, but their SSH key is not attached in GitLab because SCIM provisioning for group membership and SSH key import is delayed.
description:
Issue summary:
- New hire (m.r@example.com) completed SSO onboarding and MFA.
- Web login to GitLab via Okta SSO succeeds.
- Attempting to clone via SSH (git@internal-git.redwood:repo.git) returns 'Permission denied (publickey)'.
Impact:
- Blocked developer onboarding for one engineer. Not a company-wide outage, but prevents feature work in progress.
Environment:
- Prod GitLab (self-hosted), Okta org: redwood-prod, SCIM bridge v1.4.2, SCIM sync cron configured every 5m with incremental syncs.
Steps to reproduce:
1. New user completes Okta SSO flow and is assigned to team-group:frontend-engineering.
2. User attempts web login to GitLab (works).
3. User tries to clone via SSH and receives publickey error.
4. Checking GitLab UI shows the user without any SSH keys attached and not placed in the expected GitLab group with repo permissions.
Observed behavior / logs:
- Okta: user provisioned event seen at 2026-03-10T08:12:04Z.
- SCIM bridge: incremental sync run at 2026-03-10T08:15:00Z but logs show 'partial sync completed; queued 1 tasks for manual reconciliation'.
- SCIM bridge error snippet: 'Timeout waiting for LDAP role resolution for group frontend-engineering: context deadline exceeded'.
- GitLab audit: no create/ssh-key event for user.
- User's ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub verified present and uploaded to profile UI (attempted) — UI rejects with 'Unable to validate SSH key: user not found in LDAP group mapping'.
Regressions/Related changes:
- SCIM bridge v1.4.2 deployed 2026-03-09 to address rate-limiting; introduced new LDAP group resolution path.
- No prior incidents reported for GitLab access during last 6 months.
Potential root causes (hypothesis):
- SCIM bridge LDAP lookup to on-prem LDAP is timing out intermittently due to increased load on LDAP during scheduled nightly indexing.
- New LDAP attribute mapping for 'employeeType' added in last deployment causing mismatch and preventing group resolution.
- Race condition between Okta JIT provisioning and the SCIM incremental sync window causing the user to exist in Okta but not yet reconciled into GitLab with keys/roles.
steps_to_reproduce: Create a new Okta user and assign to frontend-engineering group
Complete SSO flow and verify web GitLab login
Attempt 'git clone' using SSH and observe permission denied
Check SCIM bridge logs and GitLab user SSH key attachment

investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:00 - Support (Ethan): Verified Okta shows user and group assignment. Web SSO works; token exchange looks normal.
2026-03-10 09:18 - SRE (Priya): Inspected SCIM bridge pods; saw spikes in LDAP latency during 08:00-09:00 window correlated with nightly indexing on ldap1.redwood.internal.

2026-03-10 09:45 - Auth (Diego): Confirmed recent SCIM bridge deploy changed LDAP lookup to use 'employeeType' attribute; fallback missing for empty values. Found pending PR that rolled the change out (github.com/redwood-infra/scim-bridge/pull/482).
2026-03-11 11:22 - Workaround applied: Manually triggered full SCIM reconciliation job for affected user and group. This attached the SSH key and membership in GitLab; user can now clone.
comments: Maya Rodriguez (Reporter) [2026-03-10T08:45Z]: New hire 'M.Rodriguez' can't clone repos; web login ok. Assigned to support.
Ethan Brooks (Support) [2026-03-10T09:02Z]: Acknowledged. Collecting logs and pinging SRE for SCIM bridge health.
Priya Shah (SRE) [2026-03-10T09:20Z]: Seeing LDAP latency spikes. Adding LDAP team to this ticket. Linking runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/scim-ldap-timeouts
Diego Alvarez (Auth) [2026-03-10T09:50Z]: Noted the deploy that introduced attribute mapping change. Raised PR rollback candidate: https://github.com/redwood-infra/scim-bridge/pull/489
Jacob (LDAP admin) [2026-03-10T10:10Z]: Nightly indexing caused higher latency. We will stagger indexing across replicas tonight and monitor. ETA for change: 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC.

Ethan Brooks (Support) [2026-03-11T11:30Z]: Manual full reconciliation performed for user. Confirmed SSH key import and group membership in GitLab. User reports clones succeed. Planning follow-up to prevent recurrence.
Priya Shah (SRE) [2026-03-12T07:15Z]: Added a temporary alert on SCIM bridge LDAP lookup >1s. Will monitor for 48 hours.
resolution_notes: Workaround: Manually triggered full SCIM reconciliation for affected users to attach SSH keys and apply group memberships.
Short-term fix: Stagger LDAP indexing on replicas to reduce spikes. Deployed 2026-03-11 02:30 UTC.
Next steps: Rollback or modify SCIM bridge attribute mapping introduced in PR #482 to fallback when employeeType is empty; planned patch in PR #489. Monitor for 48 hours after change.
Owner: Auth team (Diego) for permanent fix; SRE (Priya) for monitoring and alerting.
follow_up_tasks: Auth: Revert/patch attribute mapping in scim-bridge and add unit test for empty employeeType - due 2026-03-15
SRE: Keep SCIM-LDAP latency alert for 48h and remove after stability confirmed - due 2026-03-14
Onboarding: Add step to verify SSH key provisioning post-SSO for first-day checklist
